<section class="course-practicalities-section">
<h2><i class="bi bi-geo-alt-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>Venue</h2>
<p>The training will take place at SciLifeLab Solna in Solna.</p>
<div class="course-practicalities-venue">
<div class="course-practicalities-venue-details"><div><strong>Address</strong><div class="course-practicalities-address">Tomtebodavägen 23A<br>171 65 Solna<br>Sweden<br></div></div>
<div><strong>Room</strong><div>Air & Fire (lectures) and the computer room (exercises)</div></div>
<div><strong>Entrance</strong><div>Enter through the main entrance, and collect your visitor badge at the reception on the ground floor. Air & Fire is on the ground floor, next to the café. Someone from the team will walk you to the computer room after the first session.
</div></div></div>
<div class="course-practicalities-map-column"><div class="course-practicalities-map"><iframe src="https://www.openstreetmap.org/export/embed.html?bbox=18.021758000000002,59.349537,18.023008,59.350787&layer=mapnik&marker=59.350162,18.022383" title="Venue map" loading="lazy"></iframe></div><a class="course-practicalities-map-link" href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=59.350162&mlon=18.022383#map=19/59.350162/18.022383" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>Open map </a></div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="course-practicalities-section">
<h2><i class="bi bi-bus-front-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>Transport</h2>
<p>The nearest stops are Karolinska institutet västra (bus) and Solna station (commuter train), both about a ten-minute walk away.
</p>
<ul class="course-practicalities-links">

</p>

<section class="course-practicalities-section">
<h2><i class="bi bi-cup-hot-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>Food &amp; refreshments</h2>
<p>Coffee, tea and fruit are served during the breaks, and lunch is included on all three days.
</p>
<p>Tell us about allergies or dietary requirements when you register, or email intro-r@example.org at least one week before the training.
</p>

<section class="course-practicalities-section">
<h2><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-text-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>Other information</h2>
<div class="course-practicalities-additional">
<div class="course-practicalities-additional-item"><h3>What to bring</h3><p>Your own laptop and charger, with R and RStudio installed. See the Preparation page for instructions.
</p></div>
<div class="course-practicalities-additional-item"><h3>Wi-Fi</h3><p>Use eduroam if your university has it. Otherwise, ask at the reception for a guest account.</p></div>
